title: Symphony Sketchpad
description: Draw a picture, then hear it played back. Twenty-one instruments, each one a colour: pick one and draw, and the stroke sounds as you make it, pitched by how high up the canvas your finger is and quantised to a major pentatonic so nothing you draw is wrong. Press play and a plane of light sweeps across, firing every point it passes through — the picture is the score. Nothing is sampled and nothing is a bare oscillator either: each voice is built from a real harmonic spectrum, then run through a generated convolution reverb, a ping-pong delay and a master limiter, and placed in the stereo field by where it sits on the canvas. How fast you drew a point sets how loud and bright it sounds. Rendered in three.js with a proper bloom pipeline, so the strokes read as light rather than as lines.
